subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read or think about the story and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
A book called 'The Lost Puppy' is most likely about:
A) A puppy that gets lost
B) A big truck
C) A rainy day
items.answer: A) A puppy that gets lost

steps: Use the title. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) A puppy that gets lost

items.prompt:
When we read together, we should:
A) Talk over others
B) Listen and look at the pages
C) Close our eyes
items.answer: B) Listen and look at the pages

solution.answer: B) Listen and look at the pages

items.prompt:
Read.

The dog guarded the house all night.

What did the dog do?
A) Slept all day
B) Guarded the house
C) Ran away

Read.

The ant stored food all summer. In winter it had plenty.

Why did the ant have food in winter?
A) It played all summer
B) It stored food all summer
C) It was lucky
items.answer: B) It stored food all summer

steps: The story tells why. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) It stored food all summer

items.prompt:

items.prompt:
